dual_route_strategy.phase_1_description: Legacy POST /api/server/select emette WARNING via logger 'divine.deprecation'. Behavior invariato.

phase_2_design.name: dual_route_compat_phase
phase_2_design.semantics: future SLC-H-shaped server selection on server_profiles collection (account-wide, archived flip)
phase_2_design.response_compatibility: both routes return identical response shape; only the underlying source-of-truth differs (users.server vs server_profiles.active)
phase_2_design.alias_strategy: new route is alias-with-extended-semantics, NOT a strict mirror: writes go to server_profiles AND mirror to users.server during dual-write phase
phase_2_design.fallback_policy: if server_profiles collection or active doc missing, fallback to legacy users.server behavior; surfaces single 'fallback_used' counter via /api/server/select deprecation logger

phase_3_design.name: legacy_removal_phase
preconditions: server_profiles collection populated for all active users (V8 BLOCK_A apply pack DONE)
unique index (user_id, server_id) live and verified
divine.deprecation log shows < 0.1% legacy calls / day for 7 consecutive days
frontend migrated to /api/server-profiles/select OR proxy in place
explicit user approval message authorizing removal
rollback path: re-add legacy route via single commit (kept in attic /app/backend/_attic/legacy_server_select.py)
phase_3_design.removal_method: replace the route body with a 410 GONE response, keep route definition for one release as legacy_sunset, then remove

phase_4_design.name: users_server_field_drop_phase
preconditions: no read path on users.server field anywhere in backend
phase_4_design.action: drop users.server field via background migration (separate authorized ops pack)

fallback_policy_matrix.action: new route returns 503; legacy route unchanged
new route falls back to users.server via internal helper; emits 'fallback_used' log
server_profiles wins; emits 'conflict_resolved_via_server_profiles' log; legacy users.server NOT auto-updated in dual-write phase (manual reconcile)
